title: LUKS (Linux Unified Key Setup) signature
summary: A LUKS-encrypted volume begins with the 6-byte signature 'LUKS\xBA\xBE' (0x4C 0x55 0x4B 0x53 0xBA 0xBE) at offset 0.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LUKS header contains cipher, mode, hash, key slots, and the encrypted master key.
LUKS is the standard for disk encryption on Linux.
LUKS2 adds support for larger headers, tokens, and integrity protection.
